title.text: 1-Hour Spree Cruise on a Heated Glass-Roof Boat with a Live Guide

pills.label: Live Guide DE/EN
pills.pop_html: A real guide, not a recording. The commentary is given live in German and English on every departure.No audio guide in other languages. For French, Spanish or Italian, pick #3.

pills.label: Glass Roof + Heating
pills.pop_html: Weatherproof. The glass roof opens on sunny days and closes in rain; the cabin is heated when it is cold. Toilet on board.Sails daily from March to December on MS Carola or MS Franziska.

pills.label: Classic City Loop
pills.pop_html: The 1-hour central loop: Humboldt Forum, Nikolaiviertel, Museum Island, Tränenpalast, Reichstag, Hauptbahnhof, Chancellery and Haus der Kulturen der Welt, then back.Same route as #3 and #4. The difference is the boat and the guide.

pills.label: Not wheelchair accessible
pills.pop_html: ♿ Wheelchair: not suitable for wheelchair users or guests with limited mobility

best_for.pick_html: for the best 1-hour cruise in any weather: live guide, glass roof, €18.
best_for.skip_html: if you need a wheelchair-accessible boat: the listing says it is not suitable.

items.a: Yes, a live guide on every departure switches between German and English. There is no audio guide in other languages.

items.q: Is it good in bad weather?
items.a: Yes: the glass roof closes in rain, the cabin is heated when it is cold, and there is a toilet on board.
Reederei Hadynski, Anna-Louisa-Karsch-Straße 2, 10178 Berlin, opposite Berlin Cathedral, near S Hackescher Markt.
Daily from March to December, on MS Carola or MS Franziska.
Yes, for free up to 24 hours before.
